description: #4 — in an ordinary function body, `if (c) { … };⏎ else { … }`: the `;` ends the braced `if`, so the `else` starts nothing. Base compiled this at exit 0 only because the stray `else { … }` text leaked into the emitted JS (where the dropped `;` let it re-read as an if/else); it is now E-STMT-UNEXPECTED-TOKEN (§34: "no statement begins here"). Corpus: 0 files use the shape.
rationale: JS rejects `if (c) { } ; else { }` — an `else` must directly follow its `if`'s body. SPEC §34 E-STMT-UNEXPECTED-TOKEN: "Unexpected token — no statement begins here."
